searchTerms.title: Business types
searchTerms.description: What to search for, e.g. plumber, roofing, dentist, HVAC, auto repair. A business name works too.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: City and state or ZIP code, e.g. Austin, TX or 10001 or Toronto, ON. Each search term runs in each location.

country.title: Country
country.description: BBB covers the US and Canada.

accreditedOnly.title: BBB accredited only
accreditedOnly.description: Keep only businesses with BBB accreditation.

minRating.title: Minimum BBB rating
minRating.description: Drop businesses rated below this. NR (not rated) is dropped when this is set.

requirePhone.title: Only businesses with a phone number
requirePhone.description: Skip listings that show no phone.

strictMatch.title: Only exact category matches
strictMatch.description: BBB search also returns related trades (a roofing search brings some general contractors and gutter companies). On = keep only businesses whose name or BBB categories contain the search term.

maxResultsPerSearch.title: Maximum per search
maxResultsPerSearch.description: Per search term and location. BBB shows up to 225 (15 pages) per search, so add more cities or ZIP codes for wider coverage.

maxResults.title: Maximum businesses in total
maxResults.description: Stop after this many businesses across all searches.
